title: Leaf surface acylsugar extraction and LC-MS
author: Yann-Ru Lou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xj2fkqe

steps.title: Prepare Acylsugar Extraction Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 mL of Acylsugar Extraction Solution (3:3:2 Acetonitrile:Isopropanol:water, 0.1% formic acid, 1 µM telmisartan).

substeps.instruction: Combine 375 mL Acetonitrile, 375 mL Isopropanol, and 250 mL ddH2O.
Add 1136.38 µL Formic Acid (88%) to achieve 0.1% final concentration.
Add 1000 µL of 1 mM Telmisartan (dissolved in 100% DMSO) to achieve 1 μM final concentration.
Store short term at 4°C or -20°C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Extract Acylsugars from Leaflets
steps.instruction: Extract acylsugars from new leaflets using the prepared extraction solution.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL of Acylsugar Extraction Solution into a labeled extraction vial.
Cut 1-2 small new leaflets using fine scissors or forceps and immediately place them in the vial.
Clean forceps/scissors with Acetonitrile and a Kimwipe between samples.
Tighten the cap and gently agitate the tube on a rocker for 00:02:00.

steps.title: Collect Extract and Process Tissue
steps.instruction: Separate the extraction solution from the leaf tissue for analysis and quantification.

substeps.instruction: Immediately pipette the extraction solution from the rocker vial into a corresponding LC-MS glass vial and seal with a cap.
Store LC-MS vials at -20 °C.
For quantification: discard the cap of the extraction vial containing leaf tissue and place it in a drying cabinet (~40°C).
Weigh the dried leaf tissue after 3 days or once thoroughly dried.

steps.title: Prepare LC-MS Mobile Phase A
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 mL of 10 mM Ammonium Formate, pH 2.8.

substeps.instruction: Add 630.6 mg of Ammonium Formate to 950 mL of water.
Adjust the pH to 2.8 using formic acid.
Add water to reach a final volume of 1000 mL.

steps.title: Configure LC-MS System
steps.instruction: Set up the Waters Acquity UPLC and Waters Xevo G2-XS QToF mass spectrometer with the following parameters.

substeps.instruction: Column: Ascentis Express C18 HPLC column (10 cm x 2.1 mm, 2.7 µm).
Oven temperature: 40 °C.
Flow rate: 0.3 mL/min.
Solvent A: 10 mM ammonium formate, pH 2.8.
Solvent B: 100% acetonitrile.

steps.title: Set Mass Spectrometer Parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the MS settings for negative and positive ion-mode electrospray ionization.

substeps.instruction: Negative ion-mode: Capillary voltage 2.00 kV, Source temp 100°C, Desolvation temp 350°C, Desolvation N2 flow 600 L/h, Cone voltage 35V, Mass range m/z 50-1000 (0.1s/function), Collision energies: F1: 0V, F2: 15V, F3: 35V.

Positive ion-mode: Capillary voltage 3.00 kV, Source temp 100°C, Desolvation temp 350°C, Desolvation N2 flow 600 L/h, Cone voltage 35V, Mass range m/z 50-1000 (0.1s/function), Collision energies: F1: 0V, F2: 15V, F3: 45V.
